plan: Index the catalog by the 'for' ingredient name with options pre-sorted by (priority, catalog position), making choice selection deterministic under explicit priority with catalog order as tie-breaker.

Resolve each ingredient with a recursive chain-tracked substitution walk: non-excluded ingredients pass through; excluded ones take the best catalog option, apply quantity_factor/unit/preparation, and the replacement plus any additional ingredients are re-resolved against the same exclusions, supporting chains and reintroduced exclusions; a visited-name set detects cycles.

Accumulate all observable effects (chosen IDs in application order, wording-change pairs, equipment additions/removals, yield factors, warnings, reasons) in a context object; reasons use the three pinned strings and are collected exhaustively with no early exit so every independent impossibility is reported.

Treat components as optional: resolve each with a local context and omit it with a warning on local failure (missing substitution, cycle, or unavailable component equipment), merging kept components' choices/warnings/wording into the main context.

After resolution, verify the post-substitution equipment set against available_equipment (one reason per missing item), then apply a single global Fraction scale target_yield/(recipe yield x applied yield factors) to all quantities and apply ordered wording replacements to instruction strings.

Guarantee immutability by rebuilding every returned dict/list rather than editing inputs; print_original returns authored_text verbatim; a __main__ block runs the seven executable acceptance scenarios.
mechanisms: priority-sorted catalog index for deterministic choice
recursive chain-tracked substitution resolver with visited-set cycle detection
accumulator context for choices, wording, equipment deltas, yield factors, warnings, reasons
exhaustive no-early-exit reason collection with pinned reason strings
optional components resolved in local contexts and omitted with warnings on failure
single global Fraction scaling factor applied after resolution
ordered wording replacement pass over instruction strings
input rebuilding (fresh dicts/lists) for non-mutation and verbatim authored_text printing
